_doc: Weekly Instagram posting plan.
REWRITTEN 2026-08-13 (owner's rule). The post is no longer 'one trip shape
per weekday'. Every post now carries FOUR sections, one slide each, seven
rows each, every single day:
LONG WEEKEND  2-4 nights, out Thu/Fri and back Sun/Mon where the fares
allow it. The 9-to-5 slide: burn the fewest vacation days.
WEEK LONG     7-12 nights.
TWO WEEKS     12-21 nights. Widened from 13-17 on purpose — measured
2026-08-13, only 9 destinations had a two week trip at ANY
price, so a tight window could not fill seven rows without
either padding or lowering the bar, and we do neither.
CHEAPEST      the cheapest fares out of CLT at any trip length. This slide
makes NO discount claim, which is exactly why it can always
fill seven rows and carry a thin day. A row here still wears
a green badge IF it genuinely cleared the 12% bar, and says
nothing when it did not.
NEVER AN OVERPAYMENT, ON ANY SLIDE. min_discount is 0.12 for the three trip
length sections and 0.0 for CHEAPEST — zero, not negative. A cheap headline
price that is still ABOVE what that route normally costs is exactly the SKIP
row the owner deleted in July, and it does not come back just because the
slide says 'cheapest'. Measured 2026-08-13: a pure lowest-price sort put
'91% ABOVE TYPICAL' on the slide. The bar moved to 0.0 the same hour.
The first three sections are DEALS ONLY: every row cleared MIN_DISCOUNT.
A section that cannot find seven shows fewer rows and prints the real count.
Never padded, never a lowered bar. That rule has not moved since July.
A city MAY appear in more than one section on the same day (owner's call,
2026-08-13) — Vegas for three nights in August and Vegas for fourteen in
October are two different trips. It may never appear twice inside one
section.
`shapes` and `week` below are KEPT because pipeline/render_reel.py and the
reel rotation still resolve a single daily shape. They no longer drive the
carousel.

week.angle: A full week away, round trip, verified this morning.

weekend.angle: Out Thursday or Friday, back Sunday or Monday. A real long weekend, and you burn no vacation days.

urgent.angle: Long weekend shaped, leaving inside three weeks. Short window, real prices.

friday.angle: Expedia's 2026 Air Hacks Report puts Friday as the cheapest day of the week to book a flight, about 3% under Sunday, and the cheapest day to fly overall, up to 8% under a Sunday departure. Worth knowing: for US domestic routes specifically that report still has Tuesday as the cheapest day to actually fly, roughly 14% under Sunday.

twoweek.angle: The big one. Honeymoon, anniversary, the trip you keep putting off.

0.note: Monday. Peak booking day. The money post.

4.note: Friday. Cheapest day to book and fly, per Expedia 2026.

5.note: Saturday. PLAN: city guide carousel, build trust, do not sell. The guide renderer does not exist yet, so this still posts a normal board. Flip content to guide once it does.

6.note: Sunday. PLAN: inspiration plus a Monday teaser. Renderer does not exist yet, so this still posts a normal board.

alternating._doc: Every other Sunday the two week post replaces the usual Sunday content. Twice a month max, on purpose, so it stays special. Parity is on the ISO week number.

content_mix_target._doc: Superseded 2026-08-13: every post now carries all four sections every day.

_dow: 0=Mon 1=Tue 2=Wed 3=Thu 4=Fri 5=Sat 6=Sun. depart_dow/return_dow are the days a trip may leave and come back on; omit either to mean any day. LADDER: a shape matching nothing relaxes to nights-only, then to the wide window. Every board row records which rung it landed on (row['rung']).
